目的与范围

本页面详述 RoboFrame 中的具身流水线与智能体节点（embodied_bringup、embodied_agent、ibrobot_agent 与 task_dispatch），聚焦 launch 编排（embodied_bringup）、agent 规划生命周期（agent_plan_node、ibrobot_agent）、任务与技能执行（task_executor_node、skill_executor_node）以及服务集成 src/embodied_bringup/README.md:1-5。

1. 具身 Bringup 与 launch 架构（embodied_bringup）

embodied_bringup 包是具身运行时的主执行 bringup 层 src/embodied_bringup/README.md:1-5。它读取单一事实源（SSOT）机器人配置字典（robot_config），校验约束，并为 agent 规划、安全护栏检查与技能网关操作配置节点 src/embodied_bringup/README.md:1-5。

launch 构建器（embodied.py）

embodied_bringup.launch_builders.embodied 提供 generate_embodied_nodes()，基于活跃控制模式、入口模式（hermes 或 agent）与安全约束组装最小运行时图 src/embodied_bringup/embodied_bringup/launch_builders/embodied.py:68-77。

        graph TD
    A["SSOT robot_config YAML"] -->|load_robot_config_dict| B["generate_embodied_nodes()"]
    B -->|hermes / agent| C["agent_plan_node"]
    B -->|Read-only preflight| D["safety_guard_node"]
    B -->|Runtime snapshot| E["skill_executor_node"]
    B -->|Optional entry_mode: agent| F["ibrobot_agent_node"]
    B -->|grasp_execution.enabled| G["perception_service & GraspGen"]

    subgraph "Code Entity Space"
        B["src/embodied_bringup/embodied_bringup/launch_builders/embodied.py"]
        C["src/embodied_agent/agent_plan_node"]
        D["src/safety_guard/safety_guard_node"]
        E["src/skill_library/skill_executor_node"]
        F["src/ibrobot_agent/node.py"]
    end

来源：src/embodied_bringup/README.md:1-35, src/embodied_bringup/embodied_bringup/launch_builders/embodied.py:68-77 src/embodied_bringup/test/test_embodied_launch_builder.py:81-118

2. Agent 规划节点（agent_plan_node 与 ibrobot_agent）

embodied_agent 包含 agent_plan_node，管理计划编译、安全校验、用户确认与执行流程 src/embodied_agent/README.md:1-16。当配置 embodied.entry_mode: agent 时，ibrobot_agent 提供通过进程内 planner 适配器通信的自然语言孵化入口 src/embodied_bringup/README.md:42-47。

Agent 计划状态机

agent 计划生命周期遵循严格顺序：

        stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PLANNED: "plan capture & exact identity"
    PLANNED --> VALIDATED: "read-only safety preflight"
    VALIDATED --> CONFIRMED: "bind digest, task ID, budget"
    CONFIRMED --> ACCEPTED: "execute through skill gateway"
    ACCEPTED --> TERMINAL: "success / fault / cancel"
    TERMINAL --> [*]

来源：src/embodied_agent/README.md:46-60

3. 技能与任务执行（skill_executor_node 与 task_executor_node）

技能库与 skill_executor_node

skill_library 管理带版本技能与原语动作的执行。skill_executor_node 作为不可变 RuntimeSnapshot 的运行时持有者，将原始模板编译为原语序列 src/skill_library/README.md:34-40。

        sequenceDiagram
    participant CLI as robot-skill / Hermes
    participant APN as agent_plan_node
    participant GW as skill_executor_node (Gateway)
    participant SG as safety_guard_node
    participant CC as ros2_control / MoveIt

    CLI->>APN: /embodied/plan_agent_command
    APN->>GW: /embodied/execute_skill (DispatchBinding)
    GW->>SG: /embodied/validate_skill (preflight)
    SG-->>GW: Allowed / Denied
    GW->>CC: Translate to Primitive / Joint Trajectory
    CC-->>GW: Execution Result
    GW-->>APN: Task Status (Succeeded / Failed)

来源：src/skill_library/README.md:24-32, src/safety_guard/README.md:16-30

任务分发与 task_executor_node

task_dispatch 包提供 task_executor_node，用于 moveit_planning 控制模式下的任务级执行 src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/task_execution.py:1-9。它接受 ExecuteTaskPlan action，通过 moveit_gateway 将 TaskSteps 序列翻译为协调的机械臂动作，并通过 ros2_control 下发夹爪命令 src/robot_config/robot_config/launch_builders/task_execution.py:6-9。
